note: Initial rates from the optional inputs of package.json. A rate object is created only when its input is supplied. All rates are PROVISIONAL, valid from the first fiscal year start. A company that applies a profile with codes that name a key and supplies no rate gets the readiness warning of 07, 11.3 and TAX.DEDUCTION_RATE_NOT_FOUND on the first posting with such a code. Later rates and corrections are new versions (vat-deduction-rates:create-version), never edits
